meaning:
1) to pour out, pour forth in floods, flood away
1a) (Qal) to pour out, flood away
1b) (Poal) to pour forth, pour out
1b1) of God's power (fig.)

renderings.kjv: Thou carriest them away as with a flood

elsewhere.note: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
